title: constructor-super - super() must be called even if the class extends null

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age

body:
<!--

Note that leaving sections blank will make it difficult for us to troubleshoot and we may have to close the issue.
-->

**What version of ESLint are you using?**
**What configuration and parser (Espree, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?**

I'm using the online demo with the default configuration (+ `es6`).

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

``` js
class A extends null {
    constructor() {
        super();
    }
}

new A();
```

``` js
class B extends null {
    constructor() {}
}

new B();
```

**What did you expect to happen?**

The first code should be fine, in the second ESLint should warn `2:2 - Expected to call 'super()'.`

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**

ESLint warns `3:3 - Unexpected 'super()'.` for the first code, while the second is considered fine.

**Specification:**
- In a class definition, if _ClassHeritage_ is present (so even if it is `extends null`), the class' _[[ConstructorKind]]_ internal slot is set to `"derived"`. <sup>[14.5.14](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-runtime-semantics-classdefinitionevaluation) - step 15</sup>
- When instantiating a new class<sup>[9.2.2 - [[Construct]]](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-ecmascript-function-objects-construct-argumentslist-newtarget)</sup>, _OrdinaryCallBindThis_<sup>[9.2.1.2](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-ordinarycallbindthis)</sup> (which sets _envRec.[[thisBindingStatus]]_ to `"initialized"` by calling the _BindThisValue_<sup>[8.1.1.3.1](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-bindthisvalue)</sup>) is only called if `[[ConstructorKind]]` is `"base"`<sup>[9.2.2](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-ecmascript-function-objects-construct-argumentslist-newtarget) - Steps 4 and 8</sup>, so _envRec.[[thisBindingStatus]]_ remains `"uninitialized"` even if the class `extends null`.
- The _[[Construct]]_ function<sup>[9.2.2](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-ecmascript-function-objects-construct-argumentslist-newtarget) - step 15</sup> returns the result of calling the _envRec.GetThisBinding()_ function, which throws if _envRec.[[thisBindingStatus]]_ is `"uninitialized"`<sup>[8.1.1.3.4](http://www.ecma-international.org/ecma-262/6.0/index.html#sec-function-environment-records-getthisbinding) - Step 3</sup>.
